results.title: XRP Ledger Sees Significant Increase in Activity as Network Usage Rises
results.description: The XRP Ledger has seen a significant increase in activity, with the number of transactions per closed ledger rising by 150.2% to approximately 176.33. This metric quantifies the amount of activity the network is processing during each ledger cycle, making it a more reliable indicator of network usage than metrics that may increase due to XRP's market price.

results.title: Zcash Hits 8-Year High Ahead of Grayscale's ETF Debut
results.description: Zcash has reached an 8-year high of $814 ahead of Grayscale's ETF debut on NYSE Arca, sparking a debate over flipping XRP. The price surge and increase in market capitalization to $13.74 billion were driven by the upcoming listing of the first spot Zcash fund.

results.title: Laser Digital Japan Gains First New Crypto Exchange Licence in Four Years, Lists Shiba Inu Among Six Regulated Tokens
results.description: Laser Digital Japan received approval from Japan's Financial Services Agency, marking the first new crypto exchange licence in four years. The platform will initially offer wholesale liquidity and list only six regulated assets, including Bitcoin, Ethereum and Shiba Inu, reflecting growing institutional interest and retail adoption in Japan.
